rationale: Volt-VAR curve designed to correct voltage violations: injects reactive power (q=0.2) at low voltage (0.94 pu) to boost voltage above 0.95 pu limit, stays neutral at nominal voltage (1.0 pu), and absorbs reactive power (q=-0.4) at high voltage (1.07 pu) to bring voltage down to 1.05 pu limit. Curve is strictly increasing in voltage and monotonic non-increasing in q_fraction.
